# The compilers' warnings in our code that each CI job's build gives today,
# for .github/ci/count_warnings.py: each counted once per place, with -Wall -Wextra
# on everything but third_party/ and the generated code.
#
#   <job> <count>
#
# A job fails if its count goes up. When it comes down, the job says so, and
# a later change to CI lowers the line, so a code commit never has to change
# .github/. At 0, any warning fails the job, as -Werror would.

gcc 50
clang 21
windows 43
